reason: Firmware 2.6 fixes baseband recovery after a power outage on base stations, while older versions still require a cold restart.

knowledge.summary: On base stations running firmware 2.6 or later, baseband recovers automatically after a power outage; cold restart is only needed on older software below 2.6.
knowledge.author: Sanna Siirto

knowledge.summary: Base stations on firmware below 2.6 still require a cold restart to recover baseband after a power outage.
knowledge.author: Sanna Siirto
